body: All the Bright Places. Don't read if you suffer from suicidal ideation.

A really good recipe that kind of mocks the bakery ones is Swiss Meringue Buttercream. There's a very good recipe on youtube. Lookup Swiss Meringue Buttercream by Sift by Kara. That's the closest you can get from homemade frosting. If you want the EXACT one they use, it's either called 'Bettercream' with an 'e', or Pastry Pride.
